K-14.t: Summation of Non-Military Activities in Japan, No. 14 (November 1946)
K-14.v: Second copy, misfiled as Korea No. 14
K-14.note: This PDF was filed (and uploaded to archive.org) as the Korea Summation No. 14, but it is a Google/University of Virginia scan of the Japan Summation No. 14, November 1946. Korea No. 14 is not in this collection.
